acceptanceCriteria.statement: The v2 GCR packet, schemas, authority manifest, proposal, and review page are Draft 2020-12 valid, hash-bound, path-safe, exact-commit reviewable, and bootstrap-only.
All GRR-0002, GCR-0001, S01/B01, ECR-0003/W1.A04, hold, Wave, T03, G1, backlog, Git ancestry, and witness identities in the authority manifest reproduce current immutable state.
GCR-0002 approval can be introduced only after an independent APPROVED packet review at the exact packet commit; its clean codex-branch introduction commit is the sole B00 base.
The B00 candidate changes only authorized controller/schema/test/governance paths, keeps live revision 8 during review, and cannot install or fabricate S02.

After independent B00 approval, adoption uses the exact durable write-ahead protocol and finishes as a direct-child commit changing only backlog and GCR-0002 state, records one 8-to-9 generation, and makes unsupported revision-8 readers fail closed.

Revision-9 recoveryctl accepts only independently reviewed and exactly approved sequential GRR-0002.S02/B02 authority and rejects stale, forked, wrong-hold, wrong-predecessor, non-increasing, unsupported, missing, or adverse authority byte-stably.
The original W1.A04 retry remains denied after GCR-0002 adoption and until independently approved B02; the trigger remains non-authoritative and no ordinary execution gate changes.

Child-process abrupt termination at every preparation, manifest, publication, replacement, validation, flush, and cleanup boundary leaves a fail-closed recoverable state; repeated recovery yields only the exact predecessor pair or exact successor pair and never a split pair.
Criterion-linked B00 evidence, real-Git denial coverage, governed Python quality, exact diff scope, and independent review pass with no unexplained unverified item.

verificationSelection.riskAnalysis: The change raises a shared governance-reader ceiling, adds a new exact recovery authority schema, and introduces crash-safe two-file adoption. The selected checks therefore cover immutable authority, old-reader denial, exact v3 sequencing, real-Git submission, child-process interruption, predecessor compatibility, quality, and the protected historic retry. Product and full Wave qualification remain deferred because no product/runtime path or Wave execution state changes in B00.
